changes.description: The Tinuë Solver has a new Find Non-Tak Tinuës setting. Turned on, any search that finds no tak-chain tinuë goes on to search every move.
With Find Non-Tak Tinuës on, a winning line is shown as soon as a tinuë is proven to exist, before its shortest line is found.
The Tinuë Solver's interactive mode no longer searches for non-tak tinuës unless Find Non-Tak Tinuës is on, and ignores the Depth and Nodes limits.
